commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-lb.py <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import URLError
from itertools import count
from threading import Lock

BACKENDS = [
    ("node2", "http://10.100.38.11:8080"),
    ("node3", "http://10.100.38.12:8080"),
]
sequence = count()
sequence_lock = Lock()

class LoadBalancer(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def do_GET(self):
        self.proxy()

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.proxy()

    def proxy(self):
        with sequence_lock:
            first = next(sequence) % len(BACKENDS)
        failures = []
        for offset in range(len(BACKENDS)):
            name, base = BACKENDS[(first + offset) % len(BACKENDS)]
            try:
                request = Request(base + self.path, method=self.command)
                with urlopen(request, timeout=3) as response:
                    body = response.read() if self.command != "HEAD" else b""
                    self.send_response(response.status)
                    self.send_header("Content-Type", response.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream"))
                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                    self.send_header("X-Backend", name)
                    self.end_headers()
                    if body:
                        self.wfile.write(body)
                    return
            except Exception as error:
                failures.append("%s: %s" % (name, error))
        body = ("No healthy inventory backend: " + "; ".join(failures) + "\n").encode()
        self.send_response(502)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 80), LoadBalancer).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-lb.py

[Install]

ANTRIEB_EOF
